biological_question: Within identically sampled indigenous vegetation plots across four Azorean islands, are plants with verified historical extirpation elsewhere in the archipelago more geographically/elevationally restricted in the sampled native vegetation than other recorded indigenous plants? This is a habitat/refugium association, not island-extinction risk or resettlement/rescue.

source.provider: Universidade dos Açores via GBIF Portugal IPT
source.declared_vegetation_scope: Native or better-preserved vegetation; explicitly nonrandom; ca. 200-m altitudinal sampling levels and 10×10-m plots subdivided into 5×5-m subplots
